list.name: stub
list.label: Stub
list.query: SELECT type::text || ' / ' || native_key AS __text, metric_id AS __value FROM metrics WHERE display_name = native_key ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stubs: metrics that still need a name, unit, category and type
panels.description: One row per stub and device, with what arrived in the selected time range. A stub without values in that range has empty columns. looks_like is a hint from those values only (num: every value parses as a number; bool: only true/false, on/off, yes/no). Click a native_key to see its values below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT met.metric_id, met.type::text AS type, met.native_key, s.device, s.value_count AS "values", s.distinct_values AS "distinct", s.looks_like, s.latest, s.latest_value FROM metrics met LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.metric_id, d.name AS device, count(*) AS value_count, count(DISTINCT v.value) AS distinct_values, CASE WHEN bool_and(pg_input_is_valid(v.value, 'double precision')) THEN 'num' WHEN bool_and(lower(v.value) IN ('true', 'false', 'on', 'off', 'yes', 'no')) THEN 'bool' ELSE 'str' END AS looks_like, max(m.time) AS latest, last(v.value, m.time) AS latest_value FROM measurements m JOIN devices d USING (device_id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(m.value_str, m.value_num::text, m.value_bool::text) AS value) v WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time) AND m.metric_id IN (SELECT metric_id FROM metrics WHERE display_name = native_key) GROUP BY m.metric_id, d.name) s USING (metric_id) WHERE met.display_name = met.native_key ORDER BY met.type, met.native_key, s.device;

value.title: Show the values of this stub

panels.title: Values over time: $stub
panels.description: Only values that parse as a number. A stub stores everything as text, so this casts on the fly; it stays empty for a text-valued stub.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(m.time, $__interval) AS "time", d.name AS metric, avg(coalesce(m.value_num, m.value_str::double precision)) AS value FROM measurements m JOIN devices d USING (device_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time) AND m.metric_id = nullif('$stub', '')::integer AND (m.value_num IS NOT NULL OR pg_input_is_valid(m.value_str, 'double precision')) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Distinct values: $stub
panels.description: The 200 most frequent values in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(m.value_str, m.value_num::text, m.value_bool::text) AS value, count(*) AS count, min(m.time) AS first_seen, max(m.time) AS last_seen FROM measurements m WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time) AND m.metric_id = nullif('$stub', '')::integer GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count DESC, value LIMIT 200;
